title: Consent-Lens (Offline Permission & Consent Impact Analyzer)
description: Architected an offline privacy and permission impact analyzer using local LLMs to evaluate app permissions and privacy terms without transmitting user data online. Engineered structured prompt pipelines and risk scoring algorithms.

title: RGB-T Vision Portal (NITK Research)
description: Designed and deployed an interactive web platform presenting thermal-visible computer vision research methodologies and datasets for NITK. Integrated PyTorch documentation, interactive simulations, and multi-modal vision datasets.

title: College Database System Engine
description: Engineered a high-performance in-memory database engine in C++ utilizing custom data structures for student, faculty, and fee record management without external STL database wrappers. Implemented binary file persistence and custom search indexing.

title: Intelligent Contact Management System
description: Architected a full-stack contact management application using Go for high-concurrency backend services and React + TypeScript for a responsive interface. Designed relational PostgreSQL schemas with full-text search and soft-delete functionality.

title: Compiler for Hypothetical Language
description: Built an SLR(1) parser and execution engine for a custom mini programming language, executing lexical analysis, parsing, and syntax evaluation. Computed FIRST/FOLLOW sets and constructed LR(0) state machines.

title: Smart Insurance Cost Prediction
description: Developed an end-to-end machine learning pipeline using Kaggle insurance datasets to predict health insurance premiums based on user attributes. Benchmarked Random Forest, KNN, and Linear Regression models.

title: CodSoft Data Science Portfolio
description: Conducted data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and feature engineering on structured datasets. Implemented predictive machine learning models to analyze data patterns and evaluate algorithm performance.
